system.name: STAR (RaRSQ)
system.one_liner: Rotation-augmented residual skill quantization that avoids codebook collapse of VQ-VAE's straight-through gradient when learning discrete robot skills.

content.variant_note: naive VQ and RaRSQ as two rows of the same toy embedding space, three columns for before update, gradient flow and after update, under a one-line pipeline strip
content.argues: Naive VQ gives all embeddings of one code the same gradient and lets codes collapse; RaRSQ gives them different directions and keeps the geometry, so more codes (skills) stay in use.
content.subject: A skill-quantization pipeline strip and a grid of toy embedding spaces showing gradients and codebook updates for naive VQ and RaRSQ.

lessons.what_to_learn: Pair a one-line pipeline strip with a rows-by-columns grid of one toy space (rows = methods, columns = before / during / after an update), reusing the codebook colours, so the reader sees where quantization sits and how only the gradient arrows change the outcome.
lessons.suits: Papers that change a training mechanism (gradient estimator, quantizer, loss) whose effect can be shown as movements of points in a toy space.

evidence: Comparison between naive VQ and our RaRSQ approach in the skill learning process.
STE assigns identical gradients to all encoder embeddings (hollow circles) that are quantized to the same codebook vector
RaRSQ prevents embeddings from collapsing to the same codebook vector, leading to more diverse skill representations

summary: STAR learns discrete robot skills with a rotation-augmented residual quantizer (RaRSQ) that avoids the codebook collapse caused by VQ-VAE's straight-through gradient. Figure 1 compares naive VQ with RaRSQ. A one-line strip on top shows a robot-arm image passing an encoder trapezoid, a grey feature cube, quantization against a dashed codebook of coloured bars, a coloured quantized cube and a decoder back to the image. Below, a 2 by 3 grid of the same toy embedding space has rows for naive VQ and RaRSQ and columns for before update, gradient flow and after update: hollow dots are encoder embeddings, coloured dots codebook vectors, blue curves partition boundaries, small arrows gradients. Naive VQ moves all dots of a partition the same way; RaRSQ spreads them across more codes.
summary_zh: STAR 用旋转增广的残差量化（RaRSQ）避免码本坍塌。图 1 对比朴素 VQ 与 RaRSQ：上方是编码、量化、解码的一行流程，下方 2×3 嵌入空间小图展示更新前、梯度流、更新后，朴素 VQ 梯度一致，RaRSQ 的点被推开或拉近。
